description: Fix build stage zero_work false positive when all tasks recovered from checkpoint

tasks.title: Add allTasksPassed guard and short-circuit in RalphExecutor
tasks.description: In `runRalphLoop` (ralph-executor.ts): (1) Guard the allTasksPassed reset with `skipTaskIds.size === 0` so it only fires during non-recovery. (2) After skipTaskIds processing, check if all tasks now have `passes=true`. If so, log `recovered-from-checkpoint` and return immediately with `{ completed: tasks.length, failed: 0, skipped: 0, total: tasks.length, taskResults: [], success: true }`.
acceptanceCriteria: When skipTaskIds covers all task IDs, runRalphLoop returns completed=total, failed=0, success=true without entering the main while-loop
When all tasks have passes=true AND skipTaskIds is empty, tasks are reset to passes=false and executed normally (corruption case preserved)
When all tasks have passes=true AND skipTaskIds is non-empty, tasks are NOT reset to passes=false
Log entry with 'recovered-from-checkpoint' is emitted on full checkpoint short-circuit
Partial skipTaskIds (not all tasks) still enters the main loop and only executes remaining pending tasks
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Key insertion point: after skipTaskIds processing block (around line 449) and before the main loop setup (line 451). The allTasksPassed guard change is at line 425-435.

tasks.title: Add checkpoint consistency cleanup and narrow zero_work in workflow-controller
tasks.description: In `runPipelineBuildStage` (workflow-controller.ts): (1) After reading checkpoint and detecting the change, verify each checkpoint task ID against tasks.json — only keep IDs where the task has `passes=true`. (2) If all checkpoint IDs are verified and cover all tasks, delete the redundant checkpoint early. (3) Pass only verified IDs as skipTaskIds. (4) Narrow the zero_work guard: skip zero_work when the executor result has `success=true` AND `completedTaskIds.length > 0` (checkpoint recovery was active).
acceptanceCriteria: Checkpoint task IDs that have passes=false in tasks.json are filtered out of completedTaskIds before being passed as skipTaskIds
When all checkpoint IDs are verified passed and cover all tasks, the build checkpoint is deleted before executor runs
zero_work guard does NOT fire when result.success=true AND completedTaskIds.length > 0
zero_work guard still fires for genuine zero-work (completed=0, total>0, no checkpoint recovery)
Partially consistent checkpoint (some IDs not verified) preserves the checkpoint and passes only verified IDs
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Key locations: checkpoint read at line 490-491, consistency verification before executor call at line 598, zero_work guard at line 617. The completedTaskIds variable is already available — add verification between lines 530-596.

tasks.title: Add tests for RalphExecutor checkpoint recovery and workflow-controller zero_work narrowing
tasks.description: Add unit tests covering: (1) Full checkpoint recovery — all tasks skipped via skipTaskIds, verify completed=total, success=true, no agent spawned. (2) allTasksPassed with skipTaskIds present — verify no reset. (3) allTasksPassed without skipTaskIds — verify reset happens. (4) workflow-controller zero_work narrowing — verify full checkpoint recovery does not emit zero_work. (5) Partial checkpoint recovery still enters main loop. Tests go in ralph-executor.test.ts and build-pipeline-observability.test.ts following existing patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: full checkpoint recovery returns completed=total, success=true without spawning any agent session
Test: allTasksPassed with non-empty skipTaskIds does NOT reset tasks to passes=false
Test: allTasksPassed with empty skipTaskIds DOES reset tasks to passes=false (corruption case)
Test: partial checkpoint recovery (some tasks skipped) still enters main loop
Test: workflow-controller does not emit zero_work when result.success=true and completedTaskIds.length > 0
Test: workflow-controller still emits zero_work for genuine zero-work (completed=0, total>0, no checkpoint)
All tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing test patterns: ralph-executor.test.ts uses setAcpSessionRunner mock, build-pipeline-observability.test.ts uses WorkflowController with mock repos. See also recover-build-all-pass.test.ts for the agent-runner-service recovery pattern.
